title: Ramp Mode Checklist and KPI Foldout
body:
Purpose:
This is a lightweight, operator-friendly playbook for staged rollouts (aka ramp modes). It combines a compact week-by-week roadmap tracker, a KPI foldout (baseline / current / target), and a short readiness checklist with explicit go/no-go triggers. Use this as the canonical handoff doc for the launch commander and the on-call rotation during first 14 days post-launch.

Scope and assumptions:
- Applies to new hosted-api feature gates and Dedicated capacity feature toggles.
- Assumes infra capacity reservations are coordinated with Platform (PR #312).
- Primary metrics focus: cost-per-1000-requests, median P95 latency, error rate (5xx), adoption funnel conversion (engagement -> retained request).

Ramp Modes (operator vocabulary):
1) Probe (0–1% traffic): quick smoke, validate monitoring, small cohort signals.
2) Throttle (1–10%): measure economics and latency under partial load; test caching and batching config.
3) Wave (10–50%): validate autoscaling and rollback triggers at scale.
4) Steady (50–100%): full capacity, long tail monitoring, quality regressions checks.

Week-by-week runway (compact tracker)
Columns: Week | Mode | Owner | Key actions | Gate decision (Y/N)
W0 | Probe | Priya Shah | Create smoke prompts, enable prefix cache, enable trace tags | Y
W1 | Throttle (1–5%) | Jordan Lee | Ramp to 5% if P95 latency < 350ms and errors < 0.8% | ?
W2 | Throttle (5–10%) | Miguel Ramirez | Adjust batching policy, validate cost per token | ?
W3 | Wave (10–25%) | Asha Patel | Validate autoscale policies (burst), run surge tests | ?
W4 | Wave (25–50%) | Platform lead | Confirm Dedicated fallback behavior, region failover | ?
W5+ | Steady (50–100%) | Product ops | Finalize tags, anomaly alerts, close launch retro | ?

KPI foldout (baseline / current / near-term target)
- Unit: tokens or requests as noted
1) P50 latency (ms): baseline "60" | current "—" | target "< 80"
2) P95 latency (ms): baseline "420" | current "—" | target "< 350"
3) Error rate (5xx %): baseline "1.2%" | current "—" | target "< 0.8%"
4) Cost per 1k requests (USD): baseline "$4.20" | current "—" | target "< $3.50"
5) Prefix cache hit %: baseline "12%" | current "—" | target ">= 30%"
6) Engagement conversion (first -> repeat request %): baseline "18%" | current "—" | target ">= 25%"

Quick interpretation guide (how to read foldout)
- Green: metric <= target for two consecutive reporting windows (1h aggregation for latency; 24h for cost).
- Yellow: metric between target and 1.5x target for any single window.
- Red: metric > 1.5x target OR an ascent in two consecutive windows.
- Any red triggers immediate rollback to previous model variant and paging of SRE + Platform + Product ops.

Launch readiness checklist (short actionable items)
- Operator checklist (must be ticked before moving mode):
  - [ ] Canary test run with real upstream traffic mapping (owner: Jordan Lee)
  - [ ] Autoscaling policy verified in staging with synthetic spikes (owner: Miguel Ramirez)
  - [ ] Cost guardrails configured in Console with alert thresholds (owner: Priya Shah)
  - [ ] Rollback keystone route + previous model pinned (owner: Platform lead)
  - [ ] End-to-end tracing present and sampled at 1% minimum (owner: SRE)
  - [ ] On-call runbook updated with clear paging tree and run rates (owner: Asha Patel)
  - [ ] Customer-facing communication draft (support + CS) ready (owner: Customer success)

Contingency triggers (explicit thresholds)
- Immediate rollback if:
  - 5xx > 2% for 30 minutes
  - P95 latency increases >2x baseline for 10 minutes
  - Cost per 1k requests > 2x forecasted model for 24h
- Controlled throttle if:
  - Prefix cache hit % drops by >10 percentage points and P95 rises >25%

Operator playbook snippets (short SOPs)
- How to throttle to 5%: open Console -> route-weights -> set new gate multiplier to 0.05 -> confirm rollout job ID -> annotate incident ticket.
- How to pin previous model: Console -> models -> select previous-version -> set pin -> verify live traffic logs for 5 minutes.
- How to adjust batching policy mid-ramp: open infra runbook link (linked_artifacts) -> change max_batch_size to +25% -> apply to canary pool -> monitor P95.

Ownership and escalation map (who to call)
- Launch commander: Asha Patel (pager: asha-pager)
- SRE escalation: Ethan Wu (pager: ethan-pager)
- Platform fallback lead: Miguel Ramirez
- Customer ops/CS: Priya Shah

Open questions / follow-ups
- Should we add a second cost metric for embeddings-heavy routes? (ramps with embeddings can shift economics).
- Do we want a temporary caching TTL increase for first 48h to stabilize P95 on read-heavy traffic?
- Runbook gap: need exact test IDs to validate region fallback (action: Platform to attach test job ids).

Notes to reviewer:
- This doc is intentionally compact and action-focused. For the canonical deck, see linked Confluence page. Use this doc during the 12–72 hour tight window after ramp starts; it is designed to be the single view for the launch commander.
- If approved, we will convert key tables to Console dashboards and embed the gate decisions as checklist widgets.

Revision history:
- 2024-11-05 created by Asha Patel (initial draft)
- 2024-12-02 updates: added cost triggers and prefix cache target (Miguel Ramirez)
- 2025-02-14: expanded ramp-mode SOPs and clarified rollback thresholds (Priya Shah)

End.
